"Bonfire Researcher"

Title that allows you to gain "Expertise" on Bonfire Pursuit Production. Obtained after discovering Colossus's Torch (The Top-Right discovery of the new legacy "Rhodes the Port City"), as well as having the requirements (Handicrafts and R3 Sophia). See Legacy TH5. After the Giant Statue for the chain quest and the new quest that needed.

The starter recipe: Record of a Novice Chair Maker

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
More recipe:
Record of an Advanced Chair Maker (unlocked after reaching Expertise Rank 7 of this title)
Record of an Expert Chair Maker (unlocked after reaching Expertise Rank 13 of this title)

wiki:
Max Rank: 18

How to get it:
Discover Colossus's Torch (Quest: Legacy TH5. After the Giant Statue)
Reach Sophia R3

How to rank up:
Do Handicrafts using ANY recipe.

Related recipe:
1. Record of a Novice Chair Maker (Title rank 1+)
2. Record of an Advanced Chair Maker (Title rank 7+)
